cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

mechanism: A keeps its former pupil for a slower goodbye by revisiting the tea-cooling delay after the tea has already cooled.
confusable: Not adding endless new errands: the original tea delay is revealed as time for attentive farewell and narrowed when B has a bus.
comparison: Cold tea masking goodbye versus returned shop key marking departure.
